description: The file defines the class PooledQueueCache, which is a specialized message cache used in Orleans streaming infrastructure. It manages message blocks, batching, cursor positioning, and metadata purging for high-performance message caching with minimal GC impact.

classes.name: PooledQueueCache
classes.description: A high-performance, pooled message cache designed for Orleans streaming, utilizing memory pooling and minimal GC overhead.

classes.name: Cursor
classes.description: A helper class within PooledQueueCache to traverse cached messages based on stream and sequence tokens.

methods.name: GetCursor
methods.description: Creates a cursor to iterate over messages starting at a specified sequence token for a given stream.

methods.name: TryGetNextMessage
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the next message in cache for a specified cursor.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a list of messages to the cache, updating internal structures.

methods.name: RemoveOldestMessage
methods.description: Removes the oldest message from the cache, and disposes of empty blocks accordingly.
